messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://www.cusabio.com/c-20659.html

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Sandwich ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay)

REAGENTS USED:
  - Capture Antibody (Immobilized antibody coated onto plate wells to bind target antigen)
  - Blocking Buffer (Minimizes non-specific binding)
  - Sample (Test solution containing target antigen)
  - Detection Antibody (Unlabeled primary antibody specific to a secondary epitope on the antigen)
  - Labeled Secondary Antibody (Enzyme-conjugated secondary antibody directed against the detection antibody)
  - Wash Buffer (Washes away unbound proteins and conjugates)
  - Substrate (Produces a signal upon enzymatic interaction)

STEPS:
1. Capture Coating: Dispense capture antibody and incubate at 4 C overnight (720 min).
2. Blocking: Add blocking buffer, mix, and incubate at 25 C for 60 min.
3. Washing: Wash 3 times with wash buffer.
4. Sample Capture: Add sample, mix, and incubate at 37 C for 60 min to trap target antigen.
5. Washing: Wash 3 times with wash buffer to clear uncaptured sample components.
6. Detection Incubation: Add detection antibody, mix, and incubate at 37 C for 60 min.
7. Washing: Wash 3 times with wash buffer.
8. Secondary Conjugation: Add labeled secondary antibody, mix, and incubate at 37 C for 60 min.
9. Washing: Perform 3 final wash cycles using wash buffer.
10. Substrate Reaction: Add substrate, mix, and incubate at 25 C for 15 min.
11. Detection & Readout: Measure signal; conditionally dispose based on threshold ($\ge 1$).

module fluorescence

manifest CaptureAntibody
manifest BlockingBuffer
manifest Sample
manifest DetectionAntibody
manifest LabeledSecondaryAntibody
manifest WashBuffer
manifest Substrate

instructions:

capab = dispense 100 units of CaptureAntibody
heat capab at 4c for 720m

blocker = dispense 200 units of BlockingBuffer
blocked = mix capab with blocker for 5s
heat blocked at 25c for 60m

wash1 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp1 = mix blocked with wash1 for 30s
dispose temp1

wash2 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp2 = mix blocked with wash2 for 30s
dispose temp2

wash3 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp3 = mix blocked with wash3 for 30s
dispose temp3

sample = dispense 100 units of Sample
captured = mix blocked with sample for 5s
heat captured at 37c for 60m

wash4 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp4 = mix captured with wash4 for 30s
dispose temp4

wash5 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp5 = mix captured with wash5 for 30s
dispose temp5

wash6 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp6 = mix captured with wash6 for 30s
dispose temp6

detab = dispense 100 units of DetectionAntibody
sandwich = mix captured with detab for 5s
heat sandwich at 37c for 60m

wash7 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp7 = mix sandwich with wash7 for 30s
dispose temp7

wash8 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp8 = mix sandwich with wash8 for 30s
dispose temp8

wash9 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp9 = mix sandwich with wash9 for 30s
dispose temp9

secab = dispense 100 units of LabeledSecondaryAntibody
complex = mix sandwich with secab for 5s
heat complex at 37c for 60m

wash10 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp10 = mix complex with wash10 for 30s
dispose temp10

wash11 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp11 = mix complex with wash11 for 30s
dispose temp11

wash12 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp12 = mix complex with wash12 for 30s
dispose temp12

sub = dispense 100 units of Substrate
reaction = mix complex with sub for 5s
heat reaction at 25c for 15m

signal = detect fluorescence on reaction for 10s

if (signal >= 1) {
    dispose reaction
}

dispose reaction

	dispose(reaction2[0])

main:
	capab1[0] = dispense(CaptureAntibody)
	heat(capab1[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 43200.0SECOND
	blocker1[0] = dispense(BlockingBuffer)
	blocked1[0] = mix(capab1[0], blocker1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND

	heat(captured1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	wash41[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp41[0] = mix(captured1[0], wash41[0]) @ 30.0SECOND

	wash51[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)

	wash61[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)

	detab1[0] = dispense(DetectionAntibody)
	sandwich1[0] = mix(captured1[0], detab1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(sandwich1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	wash71[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp71[0] = mix(sandwich1[0], wash71[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp71[0])
	wash81[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp81[0] = mix(sandwich1[0], wash81[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp81[0])
	wash91[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp91[0] = mix(sandwich1[0], wash91[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp91[0])
	secab1[0] = dispense(LabeledSecondaryAntibody)
	complex1[0] = mix(sandwich1[0], secab1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(complex1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	wash101[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp101[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash101[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp101[0])
	wash111[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp111[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash111[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp111[0])
	wash121[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp121[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash121[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp121[0])
	sub1[0] = dispense(Substrate)
	reaction1[0] = mix(complex1[0], sub1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(reaction1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
	signal1[0] = detect(fluorescence, reaction1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	if signal1[0] >= 1	|	true: jump bsbbif_2_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_3_f
